title: Oxva Xlim Top Fill Stainless Steel Replacement Pods
description: The OXVA Xlim Top Fill Cartridge Stainless Steel (SS) is designed specifically for use with the OXVA Xlim Pro 2 DNA Pod Vape Kit, supporting key features like Replay Mode and smart temperature control. Each pod contains a built-in Stainless Steel mesh coil, engineered to maintain consistent flavour while preventing dry hits and flavour fade—even at low e-liquid or battery levels. Available in three resistances—0.4ohm, 0.6ohm, 0.8ohm, and 1.2ohm—these pods cater to a range of MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-lung) vaping styles. The secure top-fill mechanism ensures quick, mess-free refills, while the 2ml capacity complies with UK TPD regulations. Compared to standard kanthal pods, these SS pods are rated for up to 30% longer coil life, offering improved performance and efficiency. Pod Details: 0.4ohm DTL- Use High VG (Sub-Ohm) E-Liquid ONLY These pods are compatible with the OXVA Xlim Pro 2 DNA device only , which unlocks their full functionality, including temperature control and Replay Mode. Best used with nicotine salt or 50/50 freebase e-liquids. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
